subject: Critical SLO bridge & fallback plan for Night P1/P2 coverage

From: Mike Ramirez <mike.ramirez@acmehealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Night P1/P2 coverage gap — urgent request for temporary SLO bridge

Ava,

We had another overnight P1 last night where our engineers waited ~45 mins for an on-call acknowledgement. Our contract requires a P1 acknowledgement within 15 minutes; repeatedly missing this window is impacting our clinical workflows. We understand Redwood's overnight staffing model, but Acme is in a hard go-live window for a region-critical deployment — we need a short-term remediation plan.

Can Redwood propose an exception or temporary bridge (e.g., automated fallback routing to hosted pool, SLA credits if not met, or a guaranteed on-call handoff window) while we finalize the Dedicated capacity? We need a proposal today if possible.

Relevant: incident ID ACME-9876, affected service: patient-notify, priority: P1.

Thanks,
Mike Ramirez
Director, Site Reliability
Acme Health

Subject: Re: Night P1/P2 coverage gap — urgent request for temporary SLO bridge

Mike — thank you for the write-up and for sending the incident log. I'm sorry you hit these gaps during your go‑live. We're treating this as high priority.

Quick proposal for an immediate remediation window while we finish your Dedicated onboarding:
- Bridge policy (72 hours, extendable): auto-fallback routing of P1 traffic to a staffed hosted pool between 00:00-08:00 PT for Acme-bound requests. This provides <10m acknowledgement target.
- Temporary on-call augmentation: Redwood will add two additional overnight responders on rotation for the bridge window.
- Credit guardrail: if acknowledgement >15m for a P1 during the bridge window, we will issue a one-time service credit per the contract clause 6.3.
- Rollback: automatic revert to normal routing once Dedicated is live or on Dec 1, 2026, whichever is earlier.

I can send a short SLO_proposal PDF and a runbook for the bridge. Ben — can you confirm commercial implications (credits/fee for augmentation)? Marissa/Evelyn — can you confirm ops capacity to staff the two extra overnight seats starting tonight if we sign this?

Attaching a draft SLO proposal now.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SLO_proposal_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

Ava — thanks for the quick draft. Commercial notes:
- Augmentation fee: we can cover the first 48 hours at no charge as a gesture. After that, a short-term monthly recurring surcharge of $4k for the two extra overnight FTEs unless Acme opts into a paid pilot.
- Credit exposure: the contract allows for pro-rated credits; limiting to a single one-time credit per qualifying missed P1 during the bridge window keeps exposure reasonable.
- Formal sign-off: I can approve the 72-hour bridge and the 48-hour free augmentation. Anything beyond that requires approval from Revenue Ops.

I copied Mike so Acme sees the commercial guardrails.

Ben
